endorsements.name: Netanel Ben-Simon
endorsements.label: Bugs on the Windshield: Fuzzing the Windows Kernel
endorsements.description: This talk will share our new approach for coverage-guided grammar fuzzing the Windows Kernel, and enhancements to the known approaches for fuzzing Windows Applications, triaging the bugs from the vulnerabilities, and being acknowledged in the MSRC Top 100. Read more
